instr: Follow and add: keep your pointer on the moving dot while you answer simple sums that appear below it.
clue: Keep the pointer on the moving blue dot the whole time: move the mouse, slide your finger, or hold the arrow keys (or the arrow buttons). Sums will appear below the field: choose the answer by clicking it or pressing 1, 2 or 3. Following the dot and answering the sums matter equally. Press Start when ready.
